visualStyleNotes: Data And Statistics, Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A standing chart plate with three colored bars, a category axis, a numbered value axis, and a compare guide. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / left-green / grid-blue from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Chart plate: warm paper panel (roughness ~0.5). Bars: colored warm paper blocks (red/blue/green desaturated) with slight bevel. Axes: thin warm-ink strips with tick labels. Compare lines: thin dashed warm-ink strips from bar tops to the axis. Drag handles: small warm paper nubs on bar tops. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). No emissive channels — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: bar charts as height comparisons — a standing chart plate with three colored bars, an animated grow, draggable bar tops, read dashed lines, and a category/value axis pair.

GEOMETRY: A standing chart plate. A horizontal bottom axis with three category labels (Red, Blue, Green); a vertical side axis numbered 0-8. Three block bars rise above their labels. 'Grow' animates each bar up from the axis. Dragging a handle on a bar top resizes it and updates its value tag. 'Compare' draws dashed guide lines from each bar top to the value axis to read all values.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) chart plate; (2) category axis; (3) value axis + ticks; (4) bars + handles + guide lines.

CAMERA: three-quarter from front-left, slightly above, frames the full chart; labels legible. Budget 6-10k triangles. Named nodes: ChartPlate, CategoryAxis, ValueAxis, Bars, ValueTags, GuideLines, GrowAnim. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
